adjudication.rationale:
In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` now compute the fallback calendar id as:

- `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`

When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the only time the `find` branch runs), the predicate becomes `cal.externalId === undefined` (or `=== null`), which will typically never match a real calendar externalId. This means the code no longer falls back to a destination calendar externalId (previous behavior was effectively `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` when not provided) and will likely default elsewhere (or pass `undefined`), causing update/delete to target the wrong calendar (e.g., `primary`) and fail (404) for events that were created on a non-primary calendar. This directly matches the finding’s claim about a tautological/unreachable match introduced by the diff.
